name: Rogue Streams
description: Shows every open Live TV stream inside this Jellyfin process, including ones Dashboard -> Active Sessions cannot see, and closes an individual stream through CloseLiveStream so its tuner is released. Closing is always manual.
overview: List and close open Live TV streams from the dashboard.

versions.changelog:
### 1.3.0.0
- Show the source tuner/device for every open live stream and live TV session
- Distinguish HDHomeRun, M3U, and other registered Jellyfin tuner hosts
- Mark streams whose tuner id is no longer present in Live TV configuration
### 1.2.0.0
- Add HDHomeRun settings with auto-detect and test before saving
- Remove the built-in device-specific tuner URL; each install confirms its own
### 1.1.4.0
- Load the dashboard page as a Jellyfin plugin view with a separate controller script
- Inline scripts were ignored, so the stream table never filled
### 1.1.3.0
- Publish a per-version changelog so the Jellyfin catalog can offer updates
- Keep previous versions in the plugin repository manifest
